use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ops::Deref;
use anyhow::Result;
use git2::{Diff};
use gityas_domain::models::file::{GitYasConflict, GitYasDelta, GitYasDiff, GitYasHunk};
use crate::misc;

pub fn get_commit_file_diff(repo: &git2::Repository, commit_id: Option<String>, gityas_delta: GitYasDelta) -> Result<GitYasDiff> {
    let commit = if let Some(commit_id) = commit_id.as_ref() {
        repo.find_commit(git2::Oid::from_str(commit_id)?)?
    }
    else {
        repo.head()?.peel_to_commit()?
    };

    let tree = commit.tree()?;
    let mut diff_opts = git2::DiffOptions::new();
    diff_opts
        .context_lines(3)
        .pathspec(gityas_delta.file_path);

    let diff: Diff = match commit_id {
        Some(_) => {
            let parent_tree = if commit.parents().len() > 0 {
                commit.parent(0)?.tree()?
            } else {
                repo.find_tree(git2::Oid::from_str("4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904").unwrap())?
            };

            repo.diff_tree_to_tree(
                Some(&parent_tree),
                Some(&tree),
                Some(&mut diff_opts)
            )?
        },
        None => {
            repo.diff_index_to_workdir(None, Some(&mut diff_opts))?
        }
    };

    // Process hunks for this file
    let mut hunks = Vec::new();
    let current_hunk = RefCell::new(None::<GitYasHunk>);
    // Get full file contents for old and new versions
    let old_content = if !gityas_delta.old_path.is_empty() {
        match commit_id.is_some() {
            true => get_file_content_at_commit(repo, &commit.parent(0)?, &gityas_delta.old_path).unwrap_or_default(),
            false => get_file_content_at_commit(repo, &commit, &gityas_delta.old_path).unwrap_or_default()
        }
    } else {
        String::new()
    };
    let new_content = if !gityas_delta.new_path.is_empty() {
        match commit_id.is_some() {
            true => get_file_content_at_commit(repo, &commit, &gityas_delta.new_path).unwrap_or_default(),
            false => get_file_content_at_workdir(repo, &gityas_delta.new_path).unwrap_or_default()
        }
        
    } else {
        String::new()
    };

    diff.foreach(
        &mut |_, _| {
            true
        },
        None,
        Some(&mut |_delta, hunk| {
            if let Some(hunk) = current_hunk.borrow_mut().take() {
                hunks.push(hunk);
            }

            // Start a new hunk
            *current_hunk.borrow_mut() = Some(GitYasHunk {
                old_start: hunk.old_start(),
                old_lines: hunk.old_lines(),
                new_start: hunk.new_start(),
                new_lines: hunk.new_lines(),
            });
            true
        }),
        None
    )?;

    // Add the last hunk if it exists
    if current_hunk.borrow().deref().is_some() {
        let hunk = current_hunk.borrow().clone().unwrap();
        hunks.push(hunk);
    }

    // Create the styled diff for this file
    Ok(GitYasDiff {
        old_content,
        new_content,
        hunks
    })
}

// Helper function to get file content at a specific commit
fn get_file_content_at_commit(repo: &git2::Repository, commit: &git2::Commit, path: &str) -> Result<String, git2::Error> {
    let tree = commit.tree()?;
    match tree.get_path(std::path::Path::new(path)) {
        Ok(entry) => {
            let blob = repo.find_blob(entry.id())?;
            let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(blob.content()).to_string();
            Ok(content)
        },
        Err(e) => Err(e)
    }
}

fn get_file_content_at_workdir(repo: &git2::Repository, path: &str) -> Result<String> {
    // Get the absolute path to the file
    let repo_workdir = repo.workdir().ok_or(git2::Error::from_str("Not a standard repository with a working directory"))?;
    let absolute_file_path = repo_workdir.join(path);
    // Read the file content directly from the filesystem
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(absolute_file_path)?;
    Ok(content)
}

pub fn get_merge_conflict_by_path(repo: &git2::Repository, path: &String) -> Result<GitYasConflict> {
    let mut index = repo.index()?;
    index.read(false)?;

    let conflict = index.conflict_get(std::path::Path::new(path))?;

    // Helper to load blob content as String
    let load = |entry: Option<git2::IndexEntry>| {
        if entry.is_none() {
            return String::default();
        }

        let blob = repo.find_blob(entry.unwrap().id);

        match blob {
            Ok(blob) => String::from_utf8_lossy(blob.content()).into_owned(),
            Err(_) => String::default()
        }
    };

    let merge_result = misc::merge_conflict::three_way_merge(load(conflict.our).as_str(), load(conflict.their).as_str(), load(conflict.ancestor).as_str());

    let conflict = GitYasConflict {
        ancestor: merge_result.ancestor_modified,
        ours: merge_result.ours_modified,
        theirs: merge_result.theirs_modified,
        chunks: merge_result.conflicts
    };

    Ok(conflict)
}
